name: opencode-session-hub
description: Browse every OpenCode session on your machine and keep them synced across workstations via a private Git repository.

commands.title: OpenCode Sync: Link This Machine to an Existing Repository

opencodeSessionHub.dataPath.description: Override the OpenCode data directory. Leave empty to auto-detect ($XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode, i.e. ~/.local/share/opencode on every platform including Windows).

opencodeSessionHub.syncRepoPath.description: Local path used to mirror the sync repository. Leave empty to use the extension's global storage folder.

opencodeSessionHub.syncRemoteUrl.description: Git remote URL of the private sync repository (e.g. git@github.com:you/my-opencode-config.git).

opencodeSessionHub.syncBranch.description: Branch used in the sync repository.

opencodeSessionHub.includeSecrets.description: Allow secret-class data (including session history) to be synced. Requires opencodeSessionHub.privateRepoAcknowledged.

opencodeSessionHub.privateRepoAcknowledg.description: Confirm you have verified the sync remote is PRIVATE. Session history and secrets stay local until this is true.

opencodeSessionHub.includeSessions.description: Sync OpenCode session history (opencode.db and storage/session|message|part). Also requires includeSecrets + privateRepoAcknowledged.

opencodeSessionHub.directoryMappings.description: Cross-machine path rewrites applied when resuming a session, e.g. [{"from": "C:\\Projetos", "to": "/home/user/projects"}].

opencodeSessionHub.projectSearchRoots.description: Folders searched one level deep for a project matching a session's recorded directory name.

opencodeSessionHub.autoSyncOnFocusLost.description: Automatically push session state when the VS Code window loses focus (debounced).

opencodeSessionHub.autoPullOnStartup.description: Automatically pull the latest session state when VS Code starts.

opencodeSessionHub.debounceSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity to wait before auto-pushing changes.

opencodeSessionHub.redactSecrets.description: Strip API keys, tokens and other credential-shaped strings from session data before syncing. Config files are never rewritten.
